ops.title: Teach spawnllm isolated mode to seed credentials from the macOS keychain, then drop UseHostConfig in slop-cop
ops.description:
slop-cop's LLM calls currently run against the host Claude config (`UseHostConfig: true`), so the user's global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` is loaded and all configured hooks fire on every detector and rewrite call. The project-level `CLAUDE.md` vector is already mitigated with a scratch `RunSpec.Dir`, but the global exposure remains.

Root cause is in spawnllm, not slop-cop: isolated mode seeds credentials from `~/.claude/account.json` and `~/.claude/.credentials.json` (`go/isolate.go:12-40`), with a keychain fallback that does not actually recover the login on a machine where `claude` stores credentials in the macOS keychain and neither file exists. An isolated call fails with `Not logged in · Please run /login`.

Two candidate fixes, either of which unblocks slop-cop:

1. Make `seedClaudeIsolation` genuinely recover a keychain-stored login, so isolated mode authenticates. Then slop-cop drops `UseHostConfig` and the scratch `Dir` hack entirely.
2. Expose a settings-only knob so a caller can keep host credentials while still passing `--setting-sources ""` and `--strict-mcp-config`. Currently `Isolated = !UseHostConfig` couples credential isolation and settings isolation (`go/spec.go:269`, `rust/spawnllm-core/src/plan/claude.rs:20-28`).

Option 2 is the smaller change and fixes both the CLAUDE.md and the hook exposure. Option 1 is the more complete fix.

Once either lands: pin the new spawnllm release in slop-cop, remove `UseHostConfig: true` and the scratch-`Dir` workaround from `internal/llm/claude.go`, and re-verify with the BANANAPHONE marker test described in the companion note.

Context and proof of the contamination are in the note "slop-cop LLM calls load host Claude config".

ops.text: An isolated spawnllm run (UseHostConfig unset) authenticates successfully on a machine whose claude login lives in the macOS keychain, OR spawnllm exposes a knob that passes --setting-sources "" while keeping host credentials
slop-cop's internal/llm/claude.go no longer sets UseHostConfig: true and no longer needs the scratch Dir workaround
A CLAUDE.md marker file in the working directory does not influence slop-cop rewrite or detector output
The user's global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md is not loaded into the detector prompt, and configured hooks do not fire per LLM call
slop-cop check --llm-effort=high still returns a report with both tiers ran:true after the change
